Message.MsgText: The 'filePath' parameter must be set to use the File Connector.

Explanation.p: The required parameter filePath was not specified in the File Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the filePath parameter in the Connector.

Message.MsgText: File Connector waiting for data. On attempt ''attempt count'' and will timeout after attempt ''maximum number of attempts''.
The 'filePath' parameter must be set to use the File Connector to a open file for reading.

Explanation.p: The required parameter filePath was not specified in the File Connector. Must be specified to open a file for reading.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the filePath parameter in the Connector.

Message.MsgText: The 'filePath' parameter must be set to use the File Connector to a open file for writing.

Explanation.p: The required parameter filePath was not specified in the File Connector. The parameter must be specified to open a file for writing.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the filePath parameter in the Connector.

Message.MsgText: File Connector timed out while waiting for lock on file.

Explanation.p: The File Connector must be able to lock the file it is going to read from or write to.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the program has permissions to read from or write to the file. Also, verify the file is not currently being used or locked by another program.
